quote: Upon any highway outside of a business or residence district no person shall stop, park or leave standing any vehicle, whether attended or unattended, upon the paved or main-traveled part of the highway when it is practicable to stop, park or so leave such vehicle off such part of the highway, but in every event an unobstructed width of the highway opposite a standing vehicle shall be left for the free passage of other vehicles and a clear view of such stopped vehicles shall be available from a distance of 200 feet in each direction upon such highway. This section shall not apply to the driver of any vehicle which is disabled while on the paved or main-traveled portion of a highway in such manner and to such extent that it is impossible to avoid stopping and temporarily leaving such disabled vehicle in such position.

activation.condition: highway outside business or residence district; vehicle stops, parks or is left standing on paved or main-traveled part when off-part placement is practicable

obligation.description: Leave unobstructed opposite width for free passage and clear view from 200 feet in each direction; off-part placement when practicable

numeric_conditions.condition: clear view of stopped vehicle in each direction

exceptions.source_clause: This section shall not apply to the driver of any vehicle which is disabled while on the paved or main-traveled portion of a highway in such manner and to such extent that it is impossible to avoid stopping and temporarily leaving such disabled vehicle in such position.
exceptions.description: Requires original disability and unavoidable temporary-position context; construction injection is insufficient.

timing.description: At the stop, park or standing episode; no invented duration cutoff

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: practicable to stop, park or so leave such vehicle off such part of the highway
judgment_calls_needed.note: Surveyed off-part target and shoulder geometry are measurable; practical availability remains a contextual judgment.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: unobstructed width of the highway opposite a standing vehicle shall be left for the free passage of other vehicles
judgment_calls_needed.note: Measure original vehicle footprint, pavement edges and opposing vehicle path; no invented minimum width.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: a clear view of such stopped vehicles shall be available from a distance of 200 feet in each direction
judgment_calls_needed.note: Separate 60.96 m approach sources and rays are geometric proxies; actual driver recognition remains open.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: disabled while on the paved or main-traveled portion of a highway in such manner and to such extent that it is impossible to avoid stopping and temporarily leaving such disabled vehicle in such position
judgment_calls_needed.note: Engine failure injection, body position and duration are measured; genuine disability, impossibility and temporary character require source review.
